values.note: Campspot, 1 night, 2 adults, before tax: Primitive RV Site (one site, 14, no electric) $27; Transient RV Site (30-amp, 5 sites) $45, the same Saturday and Tuesday. Plus the park's $10 Booking Fee per stay. 2027 isn't open yet. Left out: Wooded Primitive sites, 15-20 ft.

note: Perry Township (Lake County) park on Lake Erie. Campspot tags only the short wooded primitive and cycler tent sites 'Lakeview'. Park rules prohibit air conditioners and electric heaters. Boat ramp is for Perry residents and authorized campers with a permit. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $27-45 + $10 fee, 30A, Campspot, showers, phones. Changed: sites 30 -> 34 (6 nightly fit 23 ft), max 40 ft; added season May 1-Nov 1, no water hookup, laundry, dump. Waterfront left as lakeview with a re-audit lead.
flags: AIR CONDITIONING BAN (caveat for AWH): park regulations, 'Use of air conditioners and electric heaters is strictly prohibited', on sites sold as 30-amp. Put in the note.
LOCAL, ORDINARY NIGHT: yes, the public can book a night on Campspot ('Visitors can also book online via the CampSpot platform'); permits by day, week or month.

LONG-STAY TEST 4: passes. Campspot sells 10 of the 34 sites on its map by the night (8 RV-coded, 2 tent), about 3 in 10. Only 6 of them fit 23 ft (Transient 1, 02, 31, 32, 33; Primitive RV 14). 24 are not sold online, which suits the note's 'many sites are seasonal'; the Township's page states no seasonal count.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (downward): stored lakeview. The engine puts 'Lakeview Site' on only four sites, Wooded Primitive 22, 23 (15-20 ft) and cycler tents 24, 25; none of the 6 nightly sites EKKO fits carries it. The Campspot map is schematic and not to scale; placed roughly on imagery, Transient 31/33 sit about 90 m from the breakwall with the park road, parking and open lawn between, and 14 sits farther back by the woods at the SE. No site has a row on the lawn along the bluff. A view across the open lawn may exist from some, so I'm not calling it either way; those distances are estimates.

BASE PRICE RESTS ON ONE SITE: $27 is site 14 (Primitive RV, no electric, offered to Motorhome). The park's rule says at primitive sites 'vehicles are only permitted while loading and unloading' and 'Primitive camping will be permitted for overnight or weekend camping only', which reads oddly against a site sold to a motorhome. The usual night with power is $45. Local entry, so no price gate.
Pin OK: 41.7960,-81.1625 is at the park office/lot beside the camp loop. Phone 440-259-5957 is the park office on the Township's page. No closure notice; 2027 isn't loaded on Campspot yet.
